sections.name: summary
sections.value: Wave 0 freezes the wire; wave 1 runs three coders in parallel; PM composes and runs the live proofs (omp and Claude).

value.title: u0 — freeze hold/release wire + grace source
value.receipt: commit 68f6b3aa — docs/plans/136-typing-grace-gate/assets/contracts/hold-events.json (jq-valid): delivery.held / delivery.released event samples, /v1/hold and /v1/release request+response bodies, register_response_with_grace carrying typing_grace_ms, a grace block naming DEFAULT_TYPING_GRACE_MS in crates/core/src/delivery.rs as the single definition, and an invariants block (held_is_unacked, order_preserved, bypass, one_grace, no_false_typing, no_double_delivery). Field spellings derived from crates/core/src/model.rs (Event, Envelope, SeatDescriptor, DeliveryOutcome, DeliveryOrigin) and crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:399 — none invented. Cited as ref r2 in all three coder packets.
value.success: assets/contracts/hold-events.json holds canonical `delivery.held` / `delivery.released` payloads and the grace exposure sample; impl-guide unit rows cite it.
value.notes: PM-owned wave 0; both runtimes READ this file in tests.

value.title: u1 — extension: typing sensor + hold queue + status
value.success: lastEditAt from editor.onChange; HoldQueue in consumePushed (claim→hold→inject→ack) with fake-clock tests; status line; bypass for commands; reports held/released to the daemon.
value.notes: Held = unacked. No timers that survive /new without re-arming.
value.receipt: commit c1f17eb4 + 7cc63ba3 + 7ba1d395 + 4778b84c + 3669fcd0 (u1, pij-energetic-mouse). Terminal-input sensor bound to the REAL public hook (OMP 18.0.10 ExtensionUIContext.onTerminalInput, types.d.ts:164-165) after the packet's editor.onChange was proven non-public — which retires risk r1 STRUCTURALLY: a real Escape incremented the key count while a real ctx.ui.setEditorText did not, proven on the installed host with no daemon and no model turn (assets/observations/u1-sensor/evidence.jsonl). Pure clock-injected HoldQueue; hold/release carry job_id; release declared before every ack via ONE owner; session_start peek->release->claim restores FIFO. Full harness checks 8/8 in the coder's worktree; 42 scoped tests; every behavioural witness RED-first with output in assets/observations/.

value.title: u2 — daemon: held/released rows, grace exposure, honest push receipt
value.success: POST /v1/hold + /v1/release (additive) write spine rows; `pij state` renders held; PIJ_TYPING_GRACE_MS exposed additively; push receipt for extension-stream reads queued until ack.
value.notes: Vocabulary lives in crates/core/src/delivery.rs; no changes to delivery/mod.rs match arm (plan 137 baton).
value.receipt: commit b1d22042 + 0037a441 (u2, pij-immense-hawk), plus ae427e2d. DEFAULT_TYPING_GRACE_MS in crates/core/src/delivery.rs as the single definition; typing_grace_ms additive on the register response; /v1/hold and /v1/release serving Queue::defer and Queue::release_deferred (two additive port verbs, no schema and no new stored state, defer never charging an attempt); pointer worker skips Omp|Pi recipients as a latent double-delivery fix in its own right; held rows rendered in state --json. The 'honest receipt' item was WITHDRAWN as a behaviour change on u2's evidence and shipped as a regression guard proven non-vacuous by a mutation control. 489 Rust tests, clippy and fmt clean, full checks 8/8. delivery/mod.rs never opened — git log 46c9314c..main on that path is empty.

value.title: u3 — interaction gate: recency not draft-present
value.success: human-typing derives from last keystroke < grace (pane-signals/tmux evidence); draft parked ≥ grace no longer vetoes; next_retry_at ≤ grace; RED control for the old behaviour.
value.notes: Keep the `human-typing` word; change its derivation. draft_sha stays on the receipt when present.
value.receipt: commit 852f6d30 (u3, pij-silent-salmon). InteractionGate keyed on observed-edit recency, not draft presence; the constructor is ADDITIVE (with_typing_grace(tmux, idle_window, grace_ms)) so all 19 existing call sites compile untouched and only the composition root takes the real grace. A stale draft reports ComposerBusy and no longer vetoes socket delivery — the pane-typing interlock stays, because removing it would make the operation do MORE (splice into a human's draft). The old forever-veto test went RED and was rewritten with its rationale; the reviewer re-ran the crate itself (30 interaction tests, including the parked-draft release and the self-echo guard). 100+2 tests verified independently by the PM in the coder's own worktree.

value.title: compose + live proofs
value.success: Composed branch green on all gates; daemon rebuilt+restarted (with PIJ_TELEGRAM_ENV); AC1–AC6 live transcripts in assets/live-proof.md.
value.notes: Restart the daemon or Rust changes are not live.
value.receipt: commits 1969511e (compose), 73f21039/9231b38f/a8757bb4 (main convergence), 4778b84c (frame convergence), ae427e2d (review remediation). Composition found three things no unit's diff contained: two honest env resolutions of one grace (now ONE resolver, http::resolve_typing_grace_ms, shared by the register response and the gate), an obsolete pointer-worker control encoding 'the draft is the veto' (rewritten as a pair differing only in the grace), and 135's frame change moving ten literal assertions at once. Live proofs in assets/live-proof.md: AC1 held at t0+5.7s and delivered at t0+60.7s; AC2 parked draft 68s delivered with a non-empty composer; AC3 both ends; AC5 kill -9 with three rows held, all three pending/attempt=0, redelivered in order after re-register; AC6 a hours-old Claude draft delivered with the draft untouched where world B refused for 200+s. Contract fixture relocated to crates/testkit/fixtures/delivery/ because post-flight archives plan folders. harness checks 8/8 at 03:00:42Z.
